name: Miko★Gaku
source:
Miko Gakuen is a school for demons and demon maidens who want to protect the world. Main character works as an instructor there, who is in charge of three problem demons. His only needs to get them to the average level, but it's much more difficult than it sounds.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
巫女学园是一所让想守护世界的恶魔与魔女就读的学校。主人公在这里担任讲师，负责三名问题恶魔。他只需要让她们达到平均水平，但事情远比听起来困难。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
